WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT r.ordervault, u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp COLLATE BINARY
  GROUP BY r.ordervault, u.acctscope
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT acctscope, SUM(record_count) AS total
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT SUM(total) AS grand_total
  FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT s2.acctscope, s2.total, s2.total / s3.grand_total AS ratio
  FROM step2 AS s2
  JOIN step3 AS s3 ON s3.grand_total IS NOT NULL
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total
  FROM step4
)
SELECT s4.acctscope, s4.total, s4.ratio, s4.total / s5.avg_total
FROM step4 AS s4
JOIN step5 AS s5 ON s5.avg_total IS NOT NULL
